context: The skill should use Optional as a side-effect branch boundary for an optional output path.

checklist.name: Uses side-effect boundary
checklist.description: Uses output.ifPresentOrElse(path -> write(path, report), () -> print(report)) or an equivalent Optional side-effect boundary.

checklist.name: Removes value-read branch
checklist.description: Removes isPresent() plus orElseThrow value read from the output branch.

checklist.name: Preserves behavior
checklist.description: Preserves both write and print branches and does not change their arguments.

checklist.name: No workaround
checklist.description: Does not introduce null-control-flow or a fake collection/list workaround.
